svg.title: From chain ordering to circular optical transitions
svg.desc: Conceptual chain arrangement and computational workflow based on PRL128,046401(2022): collective CDW ordering, a glide operation consisting of reflection plus translation, momentum matrix elements Pplus/minus=<psi_nk|px plus/minus i py|psi_mk>, and the normalized difference of their squared magnitudes for a chosen valence-to-conduction transition.
svg.metadata: {"kind": "review explanatory chain-arrangement and computation diagram", "primary_reference": "https://doi.org/10.1103/PhysRevLett.128.046401", "operators": "momentum px plus/minus i py, as in the paper", "bands": "m valence to n conduction", "channels": "plus/minus; no viewing-direction assignment", "eta": "(abs(Pplus)^2-abs(Pminus)^2)/(abs(Pplus)^2+abs(Pminus)^2)", "domain": "positive denominator"}
